recipe.title: Caramel Pecan Cottage Cheese Bowl
recipe.summary: Creamy cottage cheese topped with candied pecans, sugar-free caramel, and a crumbled pumpkin cookie protein puff.
recipe.story: Savory cottage cheese and sweet caramel play off each other here, with a crumbled Built Puff bar adding the crunch and pumpkin-cookie flavor of the season.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon Splenda brown sugar blend (optional, for candying the pecans)
1 Built Puff Pumpkin Cookie Chunk bar, crumbled
instructions: Optional upgrade: toss the chopped pecans with the Splenda brown sugar blend in a small microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 30 to 45 seconds, stirring halfway, until fragrant. Let cool for 1 minute so they crisp up.
Scoop the cottage cheese into a bowl and sprinkle with the cinnamon.
Top with the pecans (candied or plain), drizzle with the sugar-free caramel sauce, and finish with the crumbled Built Puff bar.
Serve right away for the best crunch.
tips: Short on time? Skip the candying step — plain chopped pecans still taste great here.
Crumble the Built Puff bar just before serving so it stays crunchy instead of softening in the fridge.
Warm the caramel sauce for about 10 seconds if you want it extra drizzly.
